# Daily Equipment Log and Fuel Tending Record
Site: Oakridge Highway Widening Project - Station 142+00
Date: 04/14/2026
Attendant: Marcus Vance, Laborer Grade II

## Equipment Inventory & Run Times
| Unit ID | Equipment Type | Rated Capacity | Fuel Type | Run Time (hrs) | Fuel Used (gal) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GEN-01 | Portable Generator | 10 kW | Unleaded | 8.0 | 12.0 |
| CMP-04 | Towable Air Compressor | 185 CFM | Diesel | 7.5 | 18.5 |
| PMP-02 | Trash Pump (Dewatering) | 3 in Discharge | Diesel | 6.0 | 9.0 |
| PMP-05 | Submersible Pump | 2 in Discharge | Electric (GEN-01) | 5.5 | 0.0 |

## Refueling and Fluid Maintenance Log
- All dipsticks checked prior to 06:30 shift start; 15W-40 oil added to unit CMP-04 (1.5 qt).
- Dispensed bulk fuel from mobile transfer tank to replenish field equipment.
- Recorded total diesel dispensed across field units as 32.5 gal during the shift.
- Secondary containment berms inspected under units PMP-02 and CMP-04; clean and free of standing water.

## Operational Safety and Ventilation Checklist
- Ambient weather clear, 62°F, wind SW at 6 mph.
- Grounding rod verified securely bonded on unit GEN-01 with copper clamp.
- Placed unit GEN-01 inside the enclosed concrete culvert to ensure uninterrupted operation during scheduled trench prep.
- Fire extinguisher 20 lb ABC verified present on the utility fuel skid, inspection tag dated 03/2026.
- Spark arrestor screen on unit CMP-04 inspected and cleared of carbon deposits.

errors.quote: total diesel dispensed across field units as 32.5 gal
errors.explanation: The table lists diesel consumption as 18.5 gal for CMP-04 and 9.0 gal for PMP-02 (the only two diesel units), which totals 27.5 gal, not 32.5 gal.
errors.fix: total diesel dispensed across field units as 27.5 gal

errors.quote: Placed unit GEN-01 inside the enclosed concrete culvert to ensure uninterrupted operation
errors.explanation: Operating an internal combustion engine generator inside an enclosed space violates OSHA standard 29 CFR 1926.404(b) / 1926.57 due to lethal carbon monoxide accumulation and asphyxiation hazards.
errors.fix: Placed unit GEN-01 in an open, well-ventilated outdoor area to ensure uninterrupted operation
